Timer.documentation: Current timer state: STATE_STOPPED, STATE_COUNTING, or STATE_PAUSED (read-only)

Timer.documentation: Remaining time until OnTimer event fires in milliseconds (read-only)

Timer.label: MODE_COUNT_DOWN
Timer.detail: = 0 — Countdown mode - timer fires once after specified time
Timer.documentation: Countdown mode - timer fires once after specified time

Timer.label: MODE_INTERVAL
Timer.detail: = 1 — Interval mode - timer fires repeatedly at specified intervals
Timer.documentation: Interval mode - timer fires repeatedly at specified intervals

Timer.label: EVENT_ON_TIMER
Timer.detail: = 0 — Event fired when timer completes a countdown or interval
Timer.documentation: Event fired when timer completes a countdown or interval

Timer.label: new
Timer.detail: (id: string|number, address: number, eventBus: table): table
Timer.documentation: Create a new Timer instance Initializes a timer object with the specified parameters. The timer starts in stopped state with default values for time and mode. local timer = Timer:new("MyTimer", 1, eventBus) timer:set(Timer.FEATURE_TIME, 5000)  -- 5 seconds timer:set(Timer.FEATURE_MODE, Timer.MODE_INTERVAL) timer:execute(Timer.METHOD_START)

Timer.label: set
Timer.documentation: Set a timer feature value Sets configurable timer properties such as time duration and operating mode. Only FEATURE_TIME and FEATURE_MODE can be set; other features are read-only. timer:set(Timer.FEATURE_TIME, 10000)  -- Set timer to 10 seconds timer:set(Timer.FEATURE_MODE, Timer.MODE_COUNT_DOWN)  -- Set to countdown mode

Timer.label: get
Timer.documentation: Get a timer feature value Retrieves current timer properties including time, mode, state, and remaining value. All features can be read, though only FEATURE_TIME and FEATURE_MODE can be modified via set(). local timeRemaining = timer:get(Timer.FEATURE_VALUE) local currentState = timer:get(Timer.FEATURE_STATE) if currentState == Timer.STATE_COUNTING then print("Timer is running, " .. timeRemaining .. "ms remaining") end

Timer.label: execute
Timer.documentation: Execute a timer method Controls timer operation by executing start, stop, or pause commands. This is the primary interface for controlling timer execution state. timer:execute(Timer.METHOD_START)   -- Start/resume the timer timer:execute(Timer.METHOD_PAUSE)   -- Pause the timer timer:execute(Timer.METHOD_STOP)    -- Stop the timer completely

Timer.label: add_event
Timer.documentation: Register an event callback Attaches a callback function to be executed when the specified timer event occurs. Events include timer completion, start, stop, and pause. timer:add_event(Timer.EVENT_ON_TIMER, function() print("Timer fired!") end) timer:add_event(Timer.EVENT_ON_START, function() print("Timer started") end)
